description: Storing a whole board project as one stream split into sections (settings, device setup, VM program), verifying its CRC-32, running it and erasing it.

commands.label: Start storing a project
commands.description: Opens an upload session for a project of the given length in bytes, with what the board does with it at start (stored and applied at the commit).

fields.label: Stream length
fields.description: Total size of the stream being uploaded, in bytes

fields.label: At start
fields.description: Nothing, load, or load and start: kept as the boot option and applied right after the commit, as at a boot

commands.label: Write a chunk of the project
commands.description: Uploads the next piece of the project stream at the given byte offset.

fields.label: Chunk data
fields.description: Raw bytes of the stream chunk (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Commit the project
commands.description: Verifies the CRC-32 and that all the sections fit together, stores the project in Flash and optionally runs it.

fields.label: CRC-32 checksum
fields.description: CRC-32 checksum of the whole stream

commands.label: Cancel the project upload
commands.description: Aborts the open upload session and clears the working buffer, leaving the project stored before untouched.

commands.label: Read the project state
commands.description: Returns what is known about the stored project: whether there is one, what the board does with it at start, the active memory bank, the CRC-32 and the size.

fields.label: Project stored
fields.description: 1 = a project is stored in Flash, 0 = none

fields.label: At start
fields.description: What the board does with the project when it starts

fields.label: Active bank
fields.description: Index of the active Flash bank (0 or 1)

fields.label: Project size
fields.description: Total size of the stored project, in bytes

commands.label: Run the stored project
commands.description: Loads every section of the stored project (RUN_ALL of the project record), then runs its start section (the program starts).

commands.label: Erase the stored project
commands.description: Removes the devices the project created (the board's stay), the stored project and its program records. Stop the VM first.

commands.label: Project at start
commands.description: What the board does with the stored project when it starts: nothing, load it (the program waits), or load and start it.

fields.label: At start
fields.description: Nothing, load, or load and start

write.description: What the board does with the stored project when it starts: nothing, load it (the program waits), or load and start it.

fields.label: At start
fields.description: Nothing, load, or load and start

commands.label: Header of a stream section
commands.description: Opens a section inside the project stream (refused as a command of its own).

fields.label: Record ID
fields.description: ID of the record the section goes to (0 = the program, 0xFFFFFFFF = the start)

commands.label: Project record marker
commands.description: First frame of the project record: the bank, the CRC-32 and the length (does nothing when replayed).

commands.label: Load the stored project
commands.description: Loads every section of the stored project without its start section: the settings, the devices and the program, which stays stopped.

commands.label: Append to the project's source
commands.description: Adds one chunk at the end of the file. The offset must be the file's length.

fields.label: Byte offset
fields.description: The file's length before this chunk

fields.label: Chunk data
fields.description: The chunk's bytes (runs to the end of the frame)

commands.label: Project's source info
commands.description: The file's length, CRC-32 and number of chunks.

commands.label: Read the project's source
commands.description: Sends back one chunk of the file.

fields.label: Chunk
fields.description: From 0 to the number of chunks less one

fields.label: Chunk data
fields.description: The chunk's bytes (runs to the end of the frame)
